name: office-5-ofis

observations.note: fire door sequencer at B2 service lift corridor not working. fire door inspection not in maintenance schedule
few spk heads recessed more than 50% into ceiling at B3 service corridor
FA panel normal, no isolations, monitored by central station
tenant fit-out works on L30 under hot work permit, fire watch posted, extinguisher at hand

reference:
New OFI
2026-01 Fire door inspection and testing. Priority 1. Type: Fire door ITM. Effort: Moderate Procedural.
Description: Incorporate fire door inspection and testing into the maintenance regimen. Per NFPA 101, fire doors and their assemblies should be inspected annually and kept in working condition.
Observation: Inspection and testing of the fire door is not incorporated into the maintenance regimen. At the B2 service lift corridor, the fire door sequencer is not in good working condition.

2026-02 Sprinkler Installation. Priority 1. Type: Sprinkler Installation. Effort: Moderate Procedural.
Description: Ensure that sprinklers are properly installed and not recessed into the ceiling.
Observation: At the B3 service corridor, a few sprinkler heads recess more than 50% into the ceiling, which will impede the sprinklers' flow pattern.
